coverage.scope: Greek New Testament, 27 books, one row per token
coverage.counting_rule: line count of the 27 *-morphgnt.txt files; 187 fewer than SBLGNT v1.2, consistent with a text that predates the John 7:53-8:11 addition

license_files.says: "The SBLGNT text itself is subject to the SBLGNT EULA (http://sblgnt.com/license/) and the morphological parsing and lemmatization is made available under a CC-BY-SA License (3.0)." No licence file in the repository.

flags.text: Morphology and lemmas are CC BY-SA 3.0: a share-alike layer, kept as a separate module; prefer MACULA's CC BY morphology for redistributed derived layers (specs/19).

EULA mismatch: the README binds the text column to the old SBLGNT EULA while the current SBLGNT upstream (S06) is CC BY 4.0; the token count also shows the text is an SBLGNT edition before v1.2. The text column should be taken from S06 and only the analysis columns used from here.
flags.resolves_by: Confirm with the MorphGNT maintainers which SBLGNT version the text column reproduces and whether they consider it re-licensed under CC BY 4.0.

upstream_dependencies.license: SBLGNT EULA per README; CC-BY-4.0 upstream today

steward_proposal.rationale: Share-alike analysis over a text column whose licence statement is out of date; usable locally and as a cross-check for MACULA morphology, not redistributed.
steward_proposal.proposed_by: b003 agent (Claude Fable 5.1) for the source steward
